response.overview: Una Fairy is a curious girl, and as soon as she sees her boyfriend getting along well with Renata Fox, her neighbor, she comes up with an idea to satisfy that curiosity. Matty Mila, meanwhile, knows how to spice up a game of padel with her best friend, and it inevitably ends in a threesome. Fibi Euro is a mature woman, and when her son's friends knock on the door, she knows exactly what to do with them. Camila Henao is going to meet her new neighbors; with a game of truth or dare, she's sure to get to know them inside and out. These are the stories of Friends & Neighbors Vol. 3, featuring the sexiest girls looking for any excuse to hook up with the first guy who comes along. Don't miss it!
response.title: Friends & Neighbours 3
